D: A teenager raised in Africa starts at a US high school and gets caught up with the popular girls.
P: Serve the snacks when Cady first sees the cafeteria map.
S: Flour tortillas spread with beetroot hummus, filled with roast chicken, rocket and feta, rolled and sliced into pink spirals.
Candy canes tied in bundles with ribbon, and peppermint bark of dark and white chocolate with crushed candy cane, broken into shards.
Mini apple pies in a muffin tin, shortcrust filled with spiced apple, lattice tops, baked at 190C for 25 minutes. Pi day approved.
M: Crumbed chicken tenders, buttery mash and a crisp salad on a cafeteria tray, ranch dip on the side.
the Halloween party where everyone dresses up
Beef mince browned hard with onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and a little tomato paste, loosened with stock, spooned into warm hard shells with cheddar, shredded lettuce, tomato and sour cream.
W: Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled, piped with buttercream tinted pale pink with a spoon of raspberry purée, finished with pink sprinkles.

Fresh lemon juice and sugar syrup blended with a handful of raspberries, strained, topped with cold water and ice.

s.how: Blitz a roasted beetroot with a drained tin of chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic until pink. Spread on 4 flour tortillas, fill with 300g shredded roast chicken, rocket and 100g feta. Roll tight and slice into spirals. On Wednesdays we wear pink.

Tie candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon. Spread 200g melted dark chocolate thin and set, then cover with 200g white chocolate with a drop of peppermint and crushed candy cane. Set and break into shards.

m.note: the Halloween party where everyone dresses up
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince hard with an onion, a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp tomato paste. Loosen with 150ml stock. Spoon into 12 warm hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour cream.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and a spoon of strained raspberry purée until pale pink. Pipe and add pink sprinkles.

d.note: stop trying to make it happen
d.how: Blend the juice of 5 lemons with 150g sugar dissolved in 150ml hot water and a handful of raspberries. Strain, top with 1L cold water and pour over ice. So fetch.
